name: Abduct x Heart
source:
Princess Lifa of the Leonhart Kingdom must marry the cruel prince of the Kingdom of Drakehorn  to fulfill a treaty for a truce between warring countries. What are the countries fighting over you ask? Well, they hunger for the land of the bestial Monohoans rich in resources, which would include the native beastmen themselves. 

A Monohoan by the name of Tabi is the childhood friend of Princess Lifa. When they were children, Tabi promised the marriage avoidant princess to kidnap her if she ever must marry.

True to her word, on the day of the ceremony, Tabi kidnaps the Princess. But, to what end? Times have changed since their youth. Hearts were hardened by war. Is this kidnapping fueled by a hidden love? Or is it a plot to takedown the warring kingdoms? Can the Princess protect her country? Or will she answer the call of her stolen heart.

[From [url=https://frau.itch.io/abduct-x-heart]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
为履行交战国家之间的停战条约，莱昂哈特王国的莉法公主，必须嫁给德雷克霍恩王国残酷的王子。你问，这些国家究竟在争夺什么？它们觊觎的是莫诺霍兽人资源丰富的土地，其中也包括当地兽人本身。

名叫塔比的莫诺霍兽人，是莉法公主的童年好友。小时候，塔比曾向不愿结婚的公主承诺：如果有一天，她不得不出嫁，自己就会把她绑走。

婚礼当天，塔比果真履行诺言，绑走了公主。可她的目的究竟是什么？如今已非年少时，战争让人心变得坚硬。这场绑架，源于藏在心底的爱意？还是为了推翻交战王国的阴谋？公主能否保护自己的国家？又是否会回应那颗早已被俘获的心？

[摘自[url=https://frau.itch.io/abduct-x-heart]itch.io[/url]]
